lines: Prof. Shashikanth Suryanarayanan is a Promoter; their shares are set to be worth ₹966.75 crore (estimate, valued at offer price).
The shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 67 days ago, and are not cash; they hold 7,150,500 shares before the offer.
Minimum Promoters' Contribution stays locked until 9 Sep 2027, so part of their holding may generate value later.
